allow: Bash(/opt/homebrew/bin/fish -c 'for t in eza bat fzf gtrash starship chezmoi nvim colima docker claude go npm pnpm cargo typst aws terraform tenv kubectl dbt; printf "%-10s %s\\n" $t \(type -q $t; and echo yes; or echo NO\); end')

Bash(/opt/homebrew/bin/fish -c 'echo "fish_user_paths: "\(count $fish_user_paths\)" entries"; echo "--- type -q colima and type -q docker ---"; if type -q colima and type -q docker; echo "TRUE"; else; echo "FALSE"; end; echo "--- colima alone ---"; type -q colima; and echo colima-yes; or echo colima-NO; echo "--- GOROOT ---"; set -q GOROOT; and echo "set: $GOROOT"; or echo "UNSET"; echo "--- prefix uninstalled ---"; brew --prefix llvm 2>&1 | head -2')

Bash(/opt/homebrew/bin/fish -c 'echo "=== fish_user_paths ==="; for p in $fish_user_paths; echo "  $p"; end; echo "=== dir checks ==="; for pkg in llvm unzip coreutils findutils gnu-sed gawk grep tenv; set -l p \(brew --prefix $pkg 2>/dev/null\); printf "%-12s %-40s %s\\n" $pkg $p \(test -d $p; and echo EXISTS; or echo missing\); end')
